'''Broga's Palace''' was the palatial residence of [[Broga Masrii|Broga the Hutt]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]]. The [[Three Families]]' new [[Three Families war camp|war camp]] was between Broga's palace and the Republic's Operational Headquarters.<ref name="War Camp" /> Broga had the palace stocked with slaves and luxuriousness from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] took the palace, it became a product of great humiliation for Broga.<ref name="War Camp" /> Held by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Dracen]], the palace was eventually liberated by an individual who was working with the Three Families and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
